evidence.quote: Atlas rollback rehearsals run monthly from now on.

A rollback
we have not rehearsed is a rollback we do not actually have.

observations.why: Directive act with operational cadence language ('from now on') and a declarative that performs the settling — an unrehearsed rollback is defined as not having it, ratifying the decision as load-bearing.
Flat restatement of the cadence as a labeled fact — assertive but not itself performing ratification; the directive in src-1 carries the decision-grade settling.
Ownership asserted as a plain labeled fact; no commitment-marker or performed ratification elevates it beyond claim.

mints.name: UnrehearsedIsUnowned
mints.title: a thing we have not rehearsed is a thing we do not actually have
mints.frame: Is the conviction here performed by defining the unrehearsed as the unowned — equating preparation with possession?
